class.name: GrpcStream
class.brief_description: A bidirectional or client-streaming gRPC call.
class.description: Created by [method GrpcClient.open_stream]. Sending and receiving are independent: call [method send] for every request message and [method close_send] to half-close. Messages and the final status are delivered on the main thread. [codeblock] var stream := client.open_stream("/pkg.Service/Watch", b"", {}, 0) stream.message.connect(func(message): print(message)) stream.closed.connect(func(status): print(status)) stream.send(initial_message) ... stream.close_send() [/codeblock]

method.name: cancel
method.description: Cancels the stream. [signal closed] reports [constant GrpcClient.CANCELLED].

method.name: close_send
method.description: Half-closes the sending side. The server may still send messages until it closes.

method.name: get_messages
method.description: Returns every message received so far.

method.name: is_closed
method.description: Returns whether the stream has closed.

method.name: send
method.description: Queues a protobuf message for sending.

signal.name: headers
signal.description: Emitted once with the response headers.
